inputs.text: SSANU’s 54th National Executive Council has given the government one month to move on the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement, with an indefinite nationwide strike looming. The delay is doing useful work for somebody: universities stay under pressure, and if a strike happens, workers can be blamed while those benefiting from the stalemate remain out of sight. That’s a convenient arrangement, not a neutral failure to reach a deal.
